Excellent: Clear, confident, and polished delivery. Engages the audience effectively.
Good: Mostly clear delivery; occasional hesitations. Some engagement.
Adequate: Somewhat unclear or monotone delivery. Limited audience connection.
Needs Work: Unclear or overly quiet; little effort to engage.

Excellent: Presentation has a strong flow and clearly communicates purpose and outcomes.
Good: Mostly clear with logical structure; a few transitions are rough.
Adequate: Somewhat hard to follow; lacks organization or clarity in places.
Needs Work: Difficult to follow; unclear organization or missing key ideas.

Excellent: Slides are clean, relevant, and enhance the explanation. Visuals aid comprehension.
Good: Slides are mostly effective and support the talk.
Adequate: Slides are inconsistent or distract from the message.
Needs Work: Slides are poorly prepared or missing key visuals.

Excellent: All team members present and contribute meaningfully. Seamless transitions.
Good: All members present; most contribute clearly.
Adequate: Some imbalance in contribution; awkward transitions.
Needs Work: One or more members absent or significantly underparticipating.
